page: Amazon Web Services g6e.8xlarge is a graphics-intensive virtual server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor with 32 vCPUs (16 physical cores) operating at 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For accelerated workloads, it includes a single NVIDIA L40S GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture with 45 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 900 GB NVMe SSD, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 25 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in large language model (LLM) inference tasks. The server achieves 13,452.05 tokens per second for prompt processing and 563.96 tokens per second for text generation using a small 135M model. For larger models, it processes prompts at 874.26 tokens per second and generates text at 15.91 tokens per second on a 70B model. CPU performance is strong in single-core stress-ng tests and encryption tasks, while multi-core operations, memory bandwidth, and database operations perform within the average range.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA L40S GPU and 256 GB of system memory, this instance offers a resource-dense profile suitable for GPU-accelerated workloads without requiring multi-GPU configurations. The hardware configuration is optimized for LLM inference, graphics-intensive rendering, and data-intensive applications. It is well-suited for machine learning deployment, real-time ray tracing, and database operations that benefit from local NVMe SSD storage.
